crossRefs.note: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage, and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.
crossRefs.keyword: greet him, etc. Heb. ask him in my name of peace

crossRefs.note: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks.…
crossRefs.keyword: greet him, etc. Heb. ask him in my name of peace

people.name: Carmel
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

translations.web: David sent ten young men, and David said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.
translations.bsb: So David sent ten young men and instructed them, “Go up to Nabal at Carmel. Greet him in my name
translations.kjv: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:
translations.asv: And David sent ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:
